text:
sam: Heads-up — runbook docs/runbooks/canary-deploy.md has a 404 in the curl example. Hit it while doing a staging smoke.

courtney: ugh ok which link exactly?

sam: line ~42, the shortlink to /internal/canary-health (curl returns 404). quick grep: `rg "canary-health" docs/runbooks/canary-deploy.md`

docs-bot: link-checker: detected 404 in docs/runbooks/canary-deploy.md (rule: outgoing-links). Ticket #4821 created.

alice: I can take this. do we want to replace with the canonical /runbooks/canary-health or add a redirect?

ben: replace the snippet to point at the canonical page — redirects are flaky across environments. also add the full absolute path for the curl example so staging doesn't rely on shortlink resolution.

courtney: fine by me. small PR ok to merge today? need a staging smoke window?

sam: should be fine — tiny patch. suggested sed to update locally before opening PR:

```
sed -i "s|/internal/canary-health|/runbooks/canary-health|g" docs/runbooks/canary-deploy.md
rg "canary-health" -n docs/runbooks/canary-deploy.md
```

alice: opening PR now with this changelog and checklist in the description:
- Replace shortlink with canonical path
- Update curl example to use https://staging.redwood.local/runbooks/canary-health
- Run docs link-checker in CI

ben: please tag me as reviewer. :+1:

alice: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1284 — assigned to @ben, labelling `patch/docs` and `needs-smoke`.

docs-bot: CI: link-checker passed for PR #1284.

courtney: once merged i'll run the quick staging smoke and confirm the curl example works.

sam: thanks all. tagging docs-squad for visibility. If smoke looks good, small deploy after lunch.

alice: merged and changelog updated. closing ticket #4821. thanks!
__notes: Single-thread Slack export format: messages in chronological order as one continuous string. No title field per agents.md.
